desc:
Welcome to +1 Anime Per Step!

⚡ Take a step and gain Power. Every move builds your strength!
👥 Unlock a new Anime every 10 levels. They follow you everywhere and make you stronger with every step.
👊 Your crowd fights for you. Reach a wall and they charge in punching. Bigger crowd, faster it falls.
🌟 Claim legendary characters at the Stand, each one massively boosts your Power.
🧱 Smash through the walls blocking every corridor and unlock brand new zones.
🏆 Grab the Wins pad at each zone's end, then spend Wins on Trails and Anime Rosters.
🏋️ Keep training to earn even while you're away.
🔁 Rebirth for permanent Power multipliers and tear through zones you used to be stuck on.
🤖 Turn on Auto Wins and let your crowd farm for you.
📈 Climb the global leaderboards and become the strongest player in the game.

Can you break every wall and become the ultimate anime legend?

🎉 New Updates Every Week! 🎉
